Kimberly / team — I reviewed CloudOps_DPA_redline_v2.docx and the matrix. Summary and recommended path:

1) Scope tightening: replace broad "access to logs" language with explicit enumerated fields (IP, timestamp, routing hop id). Add a clause that prohibits access to PII and request bodies.
2) Retention: propose 30-day retention for routing logs, with automated deletion workflow and a joint deletion trigger tied to order form termination (suggested language included).
3) Audit/evidence: EdgeStream must provide either a current SOC 2 report OR a signed onboarding attestation plus a security checklist filled by EdgeStream. Both acceptable; if only attestation, we ask for an annual re-attestation.
4) Flow-down: require CloudOps to flow these commitments down to EdgeStream in writing and provide a pointer to us (Redwood) when complete.

I redlined the DPA with inline comments and suggested a short addendum (Order Form Annex A) that references the existing MSA section 6.3 and includes the retention and audit artifacts. If procurement needs a routing for DocuSign, I'll approve the addendum once EdgeStream confirms the attestations.

Two operational asks for procurement:
- procurement@cloudops-inc.com, please confirm expected DocuSign routing windows (typical CloudOps turnaround?)
- Anita: confirm whether EdgeStream will be listed publicly or kept on a closed list; redactability will change our preferred comms.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
